title: intent-test/v1
description: targets/<id>/review/tests/<id>.yaml beside <id>.lean (F26-R1, R6; D-9 v3.39): an intent test — a Lean statement about the conjecture any acceptable formalization must satisfy, run against every candidate by the gate as one of three probes (holds, covers, witness) or as a concept question. The expected result comes from the intent signer's answer, a cited source or the agreement of every surviving candidate, the record naming which; no model supplies one. Versioned, never edited (D-34).

target.description: the target the record is filed under

case.description: the case in words: the value or instance the test is about

probe.description: `holds`, the claim at the case against the expected answer; `covers`, the claim with every named concept made empty, telling holds-at from says-nothing-about; `witness`, the concept replaced by a small set, exposing the formula; `concept`, a value of one concept's predicate

concept.description: the concept a `witness` or `concept` probe is about, from the review's concepts; null for `holds` and `covers`

value.description: the expected result: true or false for a claim, or a value for a concept probe

source.description: where the expectation came from; `agreement` is the weakest, since candidates can share one mistake

ref.description: the answer record, the citation, or `agreement:<n candidates>`

author.description: who wrote the test: an identity, or `gate` for one the job derived from an answer

id.description: the record's id, lowercase alphanumerics and hyphens; a candidate's is `c-<8 hex>` of its Lean's sha256, a test's `t-<8 hex>`, a question's `q-<n>`, an exhibit's `e-<8 hex>`
